name: Onan (Judah's son)
title: Judah's second son
summary: Onan was the second son of Judah and his Canaanite wife Shua. He is known for refusing to fulfill his duty as a brother-in-law by providing an heir for his deceased brother Er, and died as a result of God's judgment on his actions.

keyEvents.title: Onan marries Tamar
keyEvents.description: After Onan's older brother Er died, Judah commanded Onan to marry the widow Tamar to fulfill his duty as a brother-in-law and raise offspring for his brother.

keyEvents.title: Onan refuses to fulfill his duty as a brother-in-law
keyEvents.description: Onan knew that the child would not be counted as his own, so he spilled his seed on the ground every time he went in to Tamar, to avoid giving his brother an heir.

keyEvents.title: Onan's death
keyEvents.description: What Onan did was evil in the Lord's sight, and the Lord also caused him to die because of his disobedience and selfishness.
